current_source_delta.interpretation: Do not expect an unchanged 84/85 total. Retain these deleted cases in the reconciliation. Their removal does not establish native broker execution, foreign refusal, or settlement coverage.

offline_analysis_use: Wait for the actual exit-code.txt and complete unpiped workspace.log, then retain source-before, source-after, source-stability and explicit environment records.
Call retained_reducer.classify(current_log, reducer_legacy_baseline, actual_exit, current_environment) to preserve its existing parsing behavior.
Do not pass the consolidation classified JSON as the reducer baseline. That code expects the older reason_lines shape.
Import retained_comparator.compare(current_reduced, baseline_reduced, reducer, cause_normalizer) and call it again against step1_reduced.
Do not execute retained_comparator.main as the consolidation comparison. Its reference constants select historical p3, pat and http_reuse runs.
Preserve raw reduced output and actual exit. Write present-day classifications separately with every failing identity and its current log lines.
Reconcile every added, absent or changed identity against current source and Cargo target ownership. No absent failure is automatically a fix.

identity_and_relocation.skip_comparison: Use Counter multiplicities, and also inspect the target executable or current Cargo package because unittests src/lib.rs alone is not unique.
identity_and_relocation.mapping_rule: Use the recorded exact file move or current #[path] declaration. Component receiving is not the directory name wamn_receiving. Keep package and test names exact.
identity_and_relocation.scope: The root Cargo workspace still runs the native test owners. Root --workspace does not replace guest builds from apps/Cargo.toml.
identity_and_relocation.diagnostics: The existing normalizer removes panic headers, including old file locations. It retains other paths and causal text. Inspect each changed path-bearing cause instead of stripping every path.

parser_limits: The native B child with the same full test name overwrites the parent diagnostic in the reducer. Read the full raw block. Step 1 lines 1973-1996 carry the actual WAMN_NATIVE_B_AUTH_PG_URL refusal at 1988-1992.
The reducer counts only the final summary per Cargo target and excludes nested child summaries. Do not count the native B child a second time.
An explicit skip needs a case diagnostic containing skipping or skipped and a final standalone ok status. Silent early returns can remain invisible.
The 85 retained explicit skips are a lower bound included in reported passes. Subtracting them does not produce an exact executed-test count.
The ARM regex also captures descriptive PG18. Keep it out of required input names unless the actual source declares an input with that name.
Historical reducer labels such as baseline_identity_cause_changed and new_potential_cutover_failure are not current root-cause classifications.
Preserve Kubernetes failure content while normalizing only its recorded timestamp and process ID. Do not normalize a changed API endpoint or a new Secret mismatch.
Check unresolved entries, failed-target footer, missing final summaries, compilation errors and exit code before interpreting counts. A partial build is not an empty or passing sweep.
Compiler errors inside successful compile-fail doctests are not failed tests. Use their final target result.
Neither expected source definitions nor separate focused runs turn missing live inputs into executed results.

special_cases.change: Baseline WAMN_DIGEST_PROFILE_M1_PLAN became WAMN_DIGEST_PROFILE_APP_PLAN in step 1. Preserve the changed input cause rather than counting it as a new failure.
